name: Asami
source: Asami is Shizuka's mother. They are both Japanese, having come to the US for work (there is an implication that it might not have been voluntary but it is never said outright) after her husband died. They work at the local spa, Asami does the cleaning and Shizuka works in the reception.
translation: Asami is Shizuka's mother.
